title: kit.monitor-status.v1
description: The status document of @saasreport/monitor (GET /status on the monitor Worker, GET /api/status on a site that mounts statusHandler). Produced by statusDocument and validated by `kit resilience watch` before it believes anything in it: an HTML page, an empty object or a document without runs and routes is not a status.

reason.description: Why the status cannot be judged (not-configured: the stale limit is not a positive whole number of minutes).

future.description: The newest run is dated more than 5 minutes ahead of the server clock.

last_attempt_at.description: null: a declared route that has never been attempted (last_reason never-attempted).

last_reason.description: The newest failure's reason code; the error text stays in the monitor's D1.

failed.description: Failed deliveries since the route's last successful one (last_ok_at), in the rows read: a failure a later delivery cleared does not count.

reason.description: A public reason code (status.js REASON_CODES); never the provider's error text, which can carry a chat id, a URL or an address.

trigger.description: cron: the scheduled run; manual: POST /run; drill: POST /run?mode=drill (an alert drill: a marked drill message through every route, whatever the health).
